Check piece size and repeat opening Specify the candy or snack shape, individual wrapping and fill weight. Test the usable opening against the largest piece and decide whether repeat closing is required. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals. Review the filled sample against shelf depth before fixing the dieline. Specify the opening For this reference, the opening is recorded as “top closure to be specified”. Agree the final opening, closure and filling route in a drawing, then request a matching sample. Resolve the material references The material and film entries describe different levels of detail or alternative options. Choose one final layer structure in the quotation; do not combine the lists into an assumed laminate. Confirm layer order, thicknesses, sealant and the testing needed for the intended contents. Confirm size and measurement basis The thickness reference is 20–200 µm (measurement basis to be confirmed). Confirm usable internal dimensions and test the intended fill quantity with the actual contents; weight, volume and flat dimensions are not interchangeable.
